{{Top|leg}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
At some point at least several [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] prior to [[4050 BBY]],<ref name="4050 date">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' establishes that [[Arca Jeth]] was instrumental in the overall defeat of the [[Nelori Marauders]] and that the group was active "[[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]" prior to Jeth becoming a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. In addition, ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' both establish that Jeth had attained that rank by the [[Time/Legends|time]] he participated in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Lorell|victory]] over the [[Lorell Raiders]]. Since ''[[Galaxy at War]]'' dates the defeat of the Lorell Raiders to approximately [[4050 BBY]], the Nelori Marauders must have been active decades prior to that date.</ref> the band of warriors,<ref name="CSWE Nelori">{{CSWECite|II|369|Nelori Marauders}}</ref> outlaws,<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]<ref name="CSWE Dachat">{{CSWECite|I|160|Dachat}}</ref> known as the [[Nelori Marauders]] launched a devastating '''invasion''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kar'a'katok]]<ref name="Hyperspace">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/96/indexp2.html|series=Aliens in the Empire|text=Part 1: Hierarchy of Power}}</ref> in order to [[Slavery/Legends|enslave]] its [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Shimholt]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CSWE Nelori" />
